biotools.summary: Provides `dplyr` verbs (`mutate`, `select`, `filter`, etc...) supporting `S4Vectors::DataFrame` objects. Importantly, this is achieved without conversion to an intermediate `tibble`. Adds grouping infrastructure to `DataFrame` which is respected by the transformation verbs.
